page.title: 命令・禁止・誘いを使い分ける

analysis.summaryJa: 相手を直接動かす肯定命令は動詞原形、してはいけないことを伝える禁止はDon't + 原形、話し手を含む共同提案はLet's + 原形、一緒にしない提案はLet's not + 原形で表す。形が似ていても、相手だけへの指示か、話し手を含む提案かという『力の向き』を文脈から見分ける。
grammarPoints: 動詞原形で肯定の指示・命令を表す
Don't + 動詞原形で禁止を表す
Let's + 動詞原形で話し手を含む提案・誘いを表す
Let's not + 動詞原形で共同の否定提案を表す
Don'tとLet's notは相手だけへの禁止か共同提案かで意味が異なる
visualEvidence: GO・STOP・TOGETHERの3つの標識で力の向きを分ける図
base verb / Don't + base / Let's + base / Let's not + base の4形式
ミニ問題でDon't rushとLet's not rushを対比し、後者を共同提案として選ぶ
commonTraps: 相手だけへの禁止Don'tと共同否定Let's notを混同する
共同提案なのに通常の肯定命令だけを選ぶ

questions.prompt: ------- your visitor badge at the security desk before entering the office.
questions.translationJa: オフィスに入る前に、警備カウンターで来訪者バッジを提示してください。
questions.explanationJa: 肯定命令文は主語を置かず、動詞原形Showで始めます。

questions.prompt: ------- use the freight elevator unless a staff member is with you.
questions.translationJa: スタッフが同伴していない限り、貨物用エレベーターを使用しないでください。
questions.explanationJa: 禁止はDon't + 動詞原形で表します。

questions.prompt: ------- review the client’s comments before we revise the proposal.
questions.translationJa: 提案書を修正する前に、顧客のコメントを一緒に確認しましょう。
questions.explanationJa: 話し手と聞き手が一緒に行う提案なのでLet's + 原形が適切です。

questions.prompt: ------- rush the safety inspection; we still have plenty of time.
questions.translationJa: 安全点検を急がないでおきましょう。まだ十分時間があります。
questions.explanationJa: 『一緒に〜しないでおこう』という否定の提案にはLet's not + 原形を使います。

questions.prompt: ------- the signed contract in the shared project folder.
questions.translationJa: 署名済み契約書を共有プロジェクトフォルダーに保存してください。
questions.explanationJa: 業務手順を直接指示する命令文なのでSaveという原形を使います。

questions.prompt: ------- leave confidential documents on the conference table after the meeting.
questions.translationJa: 会議後、機密書類を会議テーブルに置いたままにしないでください。
questions.explanationJa: 禁止事項はDon't + leaveで表します。

questions.prompt: ------- take the earlier train so we can arrive before the presentation begins.
questions.translationJa: プレゼン開始前に着けるよう、早い列車で行きましょう。
questions.explanationJa: 話し手を含む共同提案なのでLet's takeが自然です。

questions.prompt: ------- forget to attach the expense receipt to your claim.
questions.translationJa: 経費申請に領収書を添付するのを忘れないでください。
questions.explanationJa: 相手への禁止・注意はDon't + forgetで表します。

questions.prompt: ------- assume the first quotation is the best; let's compare all three suppliers first.
questions.translationJa: 最初の見積もりが最良だと決めつけないでおきましょう。まず3社を比較しましょう。
questions.explanationJa: 後半のlet's compareから話し手を含む共同判断だと分かるため、Let's not assumeが最適です。

questions.prompt: ------- meet in the lobby at 7:30 and go to the airport together.
questions.translationJa: 7時30分にロビーで待ち合わせて、一緒に空港へ行きましょう。
questions.explanationJa: 共同の行動を提案するのでLet's meetを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct instruction.

choices.A: Please checked the room number before delivering the package.
choices.B: Please checking the room number before delivering the package.
choices.C: Please check the room number before delivering the package.
choices.D: Please checks the room number before delivering the package.

questions.translationJa: 荷物を届ける前に部屋番号を確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: Pleaseの後ろでも動詞は原形checkです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct prohibition.

choices.A: Doesn't enter the laboratory without protective glasses.
choices.B: Not enter the laboratory without protective glasses.
choices.C: Didn't enter the laboratory without protective glasses.
choices.D: Don't enter the laboratory without protective glasses.

questions.translationJa: 保護メガネなしで研究室に入らないでください。
questions.explanationJa: 禁止命令はDon't + 動詞原形enterです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct invitation.

choices.A: Let's discuss the delivery options after lunch.
choices.B: Let discuss the delivery options after lunch.
choices.C: Let's discussing the delivery options after lunch.
choices.D: Let's to discuss the delivery options after lunch.

questions.translationJa: 昼食後に配送方法について話し合いましょう。
questions.explanationJa: 共同提案はLet's + 動詞原形discussです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct negative suggestion.

choices.A: Don't we book the flight until the meeting date is confirmed.
choices.B: Let's not book the flight until the meeting date is confirmed.
choices.C: Let's don't book the flight until the meeting date is confirmed.
choices.D: Let's not to book the flight until the meeting date is confirmed.

questions.translationJa: 会議日程が確定するまで、その便を予約しないでおきましょう。
questions.explanationJa: 話し手を含む否定提案はLet's not + 原形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that gives a direct workplace instruction.

choices.A: Returns the access card to reception before leaving.
choices.B: Returned the access card to reception before leaving.
choices.C: Return the access card to reception before leaving.
choices.D: Returning the access card to reception before leaving.

questions.translationJa: 退出前にアクセスカードを受付へ返してください。
questions.explanationJa: 直接の業務指示は動詞原形Returnで始めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that prohibits an action.

choices.A: Not disconnect the device while the update is in progress.
choices.B: Doesn't disconnect the device while the update is in progress.
choices.C: Don't disconnecting the device while the update is in progress.
choices.D: Don't disconnect the device while the update is in progress.

questions.translationJa: 更新中は装置の接続を切らないでください。
questions.explanationJa: 禁止はDon'tの後に原形disconnectを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that proposes a shared action.

choices.A: Let's ask the hotel to arrange a larger meeting room.
choices.B: Ask the hotel to arrange a larger meeting room, you alone.
choices.C: Let's asking the hotel to arrange a larger meeting room.
choices.D: Let's to ask the hotel to arrange a larger meeting room.

questions.translationJa: ホテルにもっと広い会議室を手配してもらうよう一緒に頼みましょう。
questions.explanationJa: 話し手と聞き手の共同行動を提案するLet's askが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that suggests avoiding an action together.

choices.A: Don't send the announcement; I will send it myself now.
choices.B: Let's not send the announcement until Legal reviews it.
choices.C: Let's don't send the announcement until Legal reviews it.
choices.D: Let's not sending the announcement until Legal reviews it.

questions.translationJa: 法務が確認するまで、その案内を送らないでおきましょう。
questions.explanationJa: 共同で差し控える提案にはLet's not + 原形を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the best instruction on a hotel checkout card.

choices.A: Leaving the key card in the box beside the front desk.
choices.B: Leaves the key card in the box beside the front desk.
choices.C: Leave the key card in the box beside the front desk.
choices.D: Left the key card in the box beside the front desk.

questions.translationJa: キーカードをフロント横の箱に入れてください。
questions.explanationJa: 手順カードの直接指示は原形Leaveで始めます。
questions.focus: サービス場面の命令文

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that clearly means “we should not make this decision yet.”

choices.A: Don't approve the supplier change; this instruction is only for you.
choices.B: Let's approve the supplier change before we see the test results.
choices.C: Let's not approving the supplier change until we see the test results.
choices.D: Let's not approve the supplier change until we see the test results.

questions.translationJa: 試験結果を見るまで、仕入先変更を承認しないでおきましょう。
questions.explanationJa: weを含む共同の否定提案という意味を明確に表すのはLet's not approveです。
questions.focus: 命令と否定提案の区別

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “You must not open this door during the inspection.”

choices.A: Let's open this door during the inspection.
choices.B: Don't open this door during the inspection.
choices.D: Open this door during the inspection.

questions.translationJa: 点検中はこのドアを開けないでください。
questions.explanationJa: must notによる禁止を直接命令にするとDon't + openです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I suggest that we review the schedule once more.”

choices.A: Review the schedule once more by yourself.
choices.B: Let's not review the schedule once more.
choices.C: Let's review the schedule once more.
choices.D: Don't review the schedule once more.

questions.translationJa: 予定をもう一度一緒に確認しましょう。
questions.explanationJa: weを含む提案はLet's + 原形で自然に言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I suggest that we avoid changing the reservation today.”

choices.A: Don't change the reservation today; this is an order only to you.
choices.D: Let's not change the reservation today.

questions.translationJa: 今日は予約を変更しないでおきましょう。
questions.explanationJa: weが一緒に避ける提案なのでLet's not changeが同義です。
questions.focus: 否定提案への言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “You should follow the signs to the registration desk.”

choices.A: Follow the signs to the registration desk.
choices.B: Let's follow the signs after registration.
choices.C: Don't follow the signs to the registration desk.
choices.D: Following the signs to the registration desk.

questions.translationJa: 登録受付まで案内表示に従ってください。
questions.explanationJa: 相手への直接助言は原形Followで命令文にできます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Employees are forbidden to share this password.”
questions.translationJa: このパスワードを共有しないでください。
questions.explanationJa: forbiddenの禁止内容を直接伝えるとDon't shareとなります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Why don't we take a taxi to the station?”

choices.A: Take a taxi to the station by yourself.
choices.B: Don't take a taxi to the station.
choices.C: Let's take a taxi to the station.
choices.D: Let's not take a taxi to the station.

questions.translationJa: 駅までタクシーで行きましょう。
questions.explanationJa: Why don't we ...? の共同提案はLet's ...で言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We should avoid discussing confidential figures in the lobby.”

choices.A: Don't discuss the figures; only you must remain silent.
choices.B: Let's discuss confidential figures in the lobby.
choices.C: Discuss confidential figures in the lobby.
choices.D: Let's not discuss confidential figures in the lobby.

questions.translationJa: ロビーでは機密の数値について話さないでおきましょう。
questions.explanationJa: we全体への否定提案なのでLet's not discussが最も近い意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Visitors are required to sign in at reception.”
questions.translationJa: 来訪者は受付で記名してください。
questions.explanationJa: requiredの手順を来訪者へ直接示すと原形Signで始める命令文になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I think we should wait for the updated forecast before leaving.”

choices.A: Wait here while I leave alone.
choices.B: Let's wait for the updated forecast before leaving.
choices.C: Don't wait for the updated forecast.
choices.D: Let's not wait for the updated forecast.

questions.translationJa: 出発前に最新予報を待ちましょう。
questions.explanationJa: we shouldの共同提案をLet's waitで自然に表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “It would be better for all of us not to rush the final review.”

choices.A: Don't rush the review; this order applies only to you.
choices.C: Let's not rush the final review.

questions.translationJa: 最終確認を急がないでおきましょう。
questions.explanationJa: all of usを含む否定的な提案なのでLet's not rushが最も近い意味です。

questions.prompt: The museum has a restricted archive area. A sign at the entrance reads, “------- enter without a staff escort.”
questions.translationJa: 博物館の制限区域入口には『職員の付き添いなしで入らないでください』と表示されています。
questions.explanationJa: 掲示による禁止なのでDon't + enterが適切です。

questions.prompt: The project team has finished the first draft. The manager says, “------- review it together before sending it to the client.”
questions.translationJa: プロジェクトチームが初稿を完成させました。マネージャーは『顧客へ送る前に一緒に確認しましょう』と言います。
questions.explanationJa: togetherが共同行動を示すためLet's reviewが自然です。

questions.prompt: A safety notice appears beside the loading dock: “------- clear of the marked area while the truck is reversing.”
questions.translationJa: 荷下ろし場の安全表示には『トラックが後退中は区画から離れていてください』とあります。
questions.explanationJa: 安全上の直接指示なので動詞原形Keepで始めます。

questions.prompt: The team has two weeks before the audit, and the records are still being checked. The supervisor says, “------- submit the final report today; we should verify the figures first.”
questions.translationJa: 監査まで2週間あり、記録確認中です。上司は『今日は最終報告を提出しないでおきましょう。まず数字を確認すべきです』と言います。
questions.explanationJa: we shouldから共同判断だと分かるためLet's not submitが適切です。

questions.prompt: A hotel guest is using the self-service luggage room. The screen displays, “------- your receipt until you collect your bags.”
questions.translationJa: ホテルのセルフ荷物預かり画面には『荷物を受け取るまで控えを保管してください』と表示されます。
questions.explanationJa: 利用手順の直接指示は原形Keepです。

questions.prompt: The IT team is installing new security software. An alert says, “------- turn off your computer during installation.”
questions.translationJa: ITチームがセキュリティソフトを導入しています。警告には『インストール中はコンピューターの電源を切らないでください』とあります。
questions.explanationJa: 警告による禁止なのでDon't turn offが適切です。

questions.prompt: Several employees need to reach the client site by 9:00. One colleague says, “------- share a taxi from the station.”
questions.translationJa: 複数の社員が9時までに顧客先へ行く必要があります。同僚が『駅からタクシーに相乗りしましょう』と提案します。
questions.explanationJa: 複数人で行う共同提案なのでLet's shareです。

questions.prompt: The supplier has sent an unverified price list. The purchasing manager tells the team, “------- circulate it yet; let's confirm the figures first.”
questions.translationJa: 仕入先から未確認の価格表が届きました。購買担当者は『まだ回覧しないでおきましょう。まず数字を確認しましょう』と言います。
questions.explanationJa: 後半のlet's confirmから共同提案の流れなのでLet's not circulateが適切です。

questions.prompt: Passengers are boarding a shuttle at a busy terminal. The driver announces, “------- the aisle clear so everyone can board safely.”
questions.translationJa: 混雑したターミナルで、運転手は『全員が安全に乗れるよう通路を空けてください』と案内します。
questions.explanationJa: 相手へ直接行動を求めるため原形Keepで始めます。
questions.focus: 公共サービスの命令文

questions.prompt: The committee has not received the legal review yet. The chair says, “------- announce the policy change until we have written approval.”
questions.translationJa: 委員会はまだ法務確認を受けていません。議長は『書面承認が来るまで方針変更を発表しないでおきましょう』と言います。
questions.explanationJa: 委員会全体の行動を保留する共同提案なのでLet's not announceです。
